name: Cresta Checkout for WooCommerce
author: CrestaProject

sections.description:
Watch the live demo

Your checkout is the page where sales are won or lost. Cresta Checkout replaces the default WooCommerce cart and checkout with a clean, focused design inspired by the best-converting stores, and gives you a small builder made only for these pages. After the purchase the order received page follows the same design.

A Shopify-style checkout for WooCommerce

Shoppers already know the checkout of Shopify stores: one calm page, the form on the left, the order summary on the right, nothing else to click. Cresta Checkout brings the same kind of checkout to WooCommerce. Start from the Split screen template and you get a two-column page with your logo and the steps (Cart, Details & payment, Confirmation) at the top, express payment buttons above the form, and an order summary that folds away on mobile behind a bar showing the total. Underneath it is still the WooCommerce checkout, so your gateways, shipping methods and extensions keep working.

Shopify is a trademark of Shopify Inc. Cresta Checkout is not affiliated with or endorsed by Shopify.

The builder

  • Drag & drop blocks with a live preview on desktop, tablet and mobile
  • Cart, checkout and order received page, each with its own layout
  • Ready-made templates and three skins to start from
  • Colours, fonts, corners and logo, applied in real time
  • Undo and redo

Conversion helpers

  • Distraction-free page, without the site menu
  • Order summary always in sight, collapsible on mobile
  • Floating labels, errors shown under each field
  • Email typo suggestions (“gmial.com” becomes “gmail.com”)
  • Free shipping progress bar that reads your shipping rules, and selects free shipping as soon as it is unlocked
  • Instant cart updates, quantity stepper, undo after removing a product
  • Cross-sells added in one click
  • Trust badges, with optional links, guarantee, customer review, payment icons, help link
  • Order received page with the thank you, bank details, summary, downloads and customer details
  • Loading animations of your choice, for cart updates and for buttons
  • Total shown on the pay button, sticky checkout bar on mobile

Works with your shop

The plugin does not reimplement WooCommerce: it still runs the classic cart and checkout, so payment gateways, shipping methods and the plugins hooked to them keep working. It takes over the page even when it contains the Cart and Checkout blocks.

On the order received page the actions of WooCommerce run as usual: bank details, downloads and the tracking scripts of other plugins stay on the page.

Multilingual shops

With WPML and WooCommerce Multilingual, the texts you write in the builder appear in String Translation under “Cresta Checkout”. Products and categories chosen in the blocks follow their translations, and fixed amounts follow the currency of the buyer.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the folder ‘cresta-checkout-for-woocommerce’ to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Open Cresta → Checkout in the admin menu
sections.faq:
Can I see the original page?

Shop managers can add ?cbc=off to the address of the cart, the checkout or the order received page. You can also switch off each page from the builder settings.

Does it load Google Fonts?

No. Fonts are system font stacks: fast, with no external requests.

Does it work with express buttons such as Apple Pay?

Yes: the gateways print them through the usual WooCommerce hooks, and the Express checkout block decides where they appear.
sections.changelog:
1.5.2

  • Everything the plugin prints is escaped right where it is printed, following the WordPress.org guidelines
  • What WooCommerce, the payment gateways and other plugins print on the order received page, the express payment buttons and the pay button goes straight to the page, unchanged
  • Translations now come from translate.wordpress.org

1.5.1

  • Minor bug fixes

1.5.0

  • Blocks can share their settings across pages: a change on one page applies to the others
  • Previews of the new Premium blocks: reward bar and next order coupon
  • The free shipping bar follows the “Apply minimum order rule before coupon discount” option of the Free shipping method, as WooCommerce does
  • No more PHP notice from the default trust badges before the layout is saved for the first time

1.4.0

  • New name: Cresta Checkout for WooCommerce, formerly Cresta Beautiful Checkout Lite. Folder, main file and text domain are now cresta-checkout-for-woocommerce; settings and layouts are kept
  • If another copy of the plugin is already active, this one waits and says which, instead of loading twice

1.3.2

  • Without Premium, the animation menus of the Style panel list the Premium animations greyed out, with a link to Premium

1.3.1

  • An animation that is no longer available falls back to the default one
  • “Try the animations” in the builder also animates a line of the cart

1.3.0

  • New order received page in the builder, with its own blocks and templates: order confirmation, payment instructions, order summary and customer details
  • The order received page keeps the bank details of transfers, the downloads and what other plugins print for the order
  • Trust badges: each text can be a link
  • WPML: the texts of the builder can be translated in String Translation, products and categories follow their translations, fixed amounts follow the currency of WooCommerce Multilingual
  • The top bar of the builder makes room for the third page on smaller screens

1.2.7

  • New tablet preview in the builder, between desktop and mobile

1.2.6

  • Without Premium, an Upgrade to PRO link next to Open builder in the list of plugins

1.2.5

  • Without Premium, the builder shows a LITE tag next to its name, with a button to upgrade to PRO

1.2.4

  • The logo gets a sparkle in the cart, and in the builder a soft tile from indigo to fuchsia with a light rim

1.2.3

  • New logo, a cart painted with one brush stroke, in the admin menu, the builder and the admin bar

1.2.2

  • The builder canvas follows a text brought back to a value already typed, for instance after deleting the last letters
  • The Save button keeps its white text when other plugins colour the buttons of the dashboard

1.2.1

  • With Premium active, its blocks stay in their own Premium group of the builder, in the same order
  • A PRO badge next to the name in the builder shows that Premium is active

1.2.0

  • Premium blocks can be previewed in the builder: a click shows them on your page with your skin and sample data, next to what they do
  • The preview is never saved and closes as soon as you edit the page

1.1.2

  • The builder lists the new Premium block Delivery estimate

1.1.1

  • Notices open the main column, aligned with the blocks, wherever WooCommerce or other plugins print them
  • Links and buttons inside notices no longer take the theme style, and notices focused for screen readers show no outline

1.1.0

  • Discounted products show the full price crossed out, in the cart and in the checkout summary
  • New link in the admin bar to edit the cart or the checkout you are looking at

1.0.9

  • Support for the two new Premium blocks, listed in the builder
  • Number fields of the builder accept decimals where a block needs them

1.0.8

  • A notice explains that with the WooCommerce block on the Checkout page, some plugins do not show their fields

1.0.7

  • A captcha placed next to the pay button is no longer wiped by checkout updates
  • The total on the pay button updates without printing the block again
  • A newsletter box cleared after an update is no longer sent as ticked
  • The coupon block of the cart fires woocommerce_cart_coupon

1.0.6

  • Products with a fixed quantity no longer show an empty quantity box in the cart
  • The quantity stepper follows the printed field, including quantities changed by other plugins
  • The quantity column is aligned across all the cart lines

1.0.5

  • New loading animations for cart updates and buttons, chosen from the Style panel
  • The pay button can always be pressed again if another plugin stops the order

1.0.4

  • Fields printed next to the pay button keep their value when the total changes
  • Blocks hidden by a condition come back as soon as the cart meets it, without reloading

1.0.3

  • Fields added by other plugins to the order group stay in sight instead of hiding behind the notes link
  • Date, select, radio and checkbox fields added by other plugins now follow the design
  • Fields without a width class take the whole row
  • A field with an error is revealed automatically, even inside a closed panel

1.0.2

  • Express buttons placed in the summary column stay visible on mobile while the summary is closed

1.0.1

  • Styles no longer depend on the theme: buttons, radios, checkboxes and fields keep their design
  • Field labels no longer touch the typed value
  • CSS generated by page builders and themes in the uploads folder is removed from the pages

1.0.0

  • Initial release
